posts.title: Nested Intelligence (II): Asking the Questions First
posts.description: Breaking the pessimistic conjecture of the first post into four questions: the structure of the chain, the optimistic and pessimistic paths, how to measure intelligence, and experiments we can run on the layer below.

posts.title: If LLMs Can Decide Without Fine-Tuning, Do We Still Need Models Like Jev?
posts.description: If the options have meaning, could a language model's learned probability distribution already contain the ability to choose? I tried reading decisions directly from existing models before deciding whether to add a specialist.

posts.title: Nested Simulation and Nested Intelligence: A Pessimistic Thought
posts.description: If intelligence could create something greater than itself, why would a nested chain remain silent? A personal reflection on limits and non-interference.
